fair_value_reason: P/E: 2028E EPS ~$9.70 (FY2027 consensus $8.45 x 1.15) x 27x (the reconciled ~29x peer median less ~7% for below-median ROIC and growth) = $262, weight 60%. EV/EBITDA: 2028E adjusted EBITDA ~$350M x 0.87 standardized ratio = ~$303M x 18.5x (peer TTM median 20.3x rolled forward) = $5.61B, less ~$330M horizon net debt, over 21.1M diluted shares = $250, weight 40%. Blend ~$258, against an agent mean of $266 (mean ~$257 once agents 1, 4 and 5's EV legs are put on a like-for-like EBITDA basis) and my round-1 $280, which used a 28-30x band before comps were built.

thesis_triggers.event: $190 is the 2026-07-29 closing low ($189.34), from before the Q2 raise. It is ~22.5x FY2027 consensus ($8.45) and ~20% below my peer-based fair value. A close there means the 2026 re-rating has fully unwound below the peer group, most likely on a guide or backlog cut (semis digestion, defense slippage), not ordinary volatility. Agent mean $189.6.

supervisor_summary: Round 2 corrected every fact I flagged, and every new fact checks out: the SEMI WFE path, missile procurement +188%, JX's +60% capacity, the director Form 4s and short interest +20% m/m. All peer forward P/Es match the source. Fair values converged from $253-325 to $247-276. That is partly anchoring on my round-1 file (the 1-month ladders and thesis breaks copy my parameters) and partly one shared data source (every agent's comps come from stockanalysis); the 12-month values are not anchored on my $280, since four of five ended below it. My one material correction: three agents apply peer EV/EBITDA to adjusted EBITDA, which runs ~15% above the standardized basis. On a ~29x materials-peer median, MTRN's 39x carries an unjustified ~36% premium given its below-peer ROIC and growth, and my fair value is ~$258 against the $312 spot. I keep the ladder close to the agent mean (P(>= $312) ~42%) with low confidence.
key_drivers: Valuation: 39.4x forward P/E against a reconciled peer median of ~29x, with ROIC (8.3% vs ~11.7%) and next-year EPS growth (+20% vs ~+24%) both below peers. No persistent premium is justified, so the return depends on EPS outrunning de-rating.
EPS path: FY2026 guide $6.80-7.20 (H1 $3.17), FY2027 consensus ~$8.45, 2028E ~$9.7. SEMI's mid-year forecast (WFE +21.8% in 2027, +14.1% in 2028) supports it; semis is ~54% of net sales.
Quality of earnings: adjusted EBITDA (~$237M TTM) runs ~15% above standardized EBITDA ($205M), and FCF only turned up in 2026 (H1 $39M).
Defense and beryllium leg: FY27 missile procurement request +188%, $65M customer-funded beryllium expansion, A&D ~20% of value-added sales. Supportive, but a minority of earnings.
Next catalyst: Q3 results likely 2026-11-04 (in-line bar, ~$1.92 implied vs $1.89 consensus), then first FY2027 guidance in Jan-Feb 2027. JX's +60% sputter-target capacity comes online in H2 2027.
